beats: setting: Sunny Meadow Vegetable Patch; event: Zuzu harvests the crunchiest, sweetest orange carrot of the season with her bright pink bow bouncing happily.; temptation: Hide the big carrot away in her burrow so nobody else can ask for a bite.; the right choice: Carry the carrot proudly to the meadow to enjoy it in the sunshine where friends play.

setting: Clover Hill Picnic Blanket; event: Zuzu sits down to nibble her snack when Pippin the hungry field mouse arrives with an empty acorn cup.; temptation: Pretend not to hear Pippin's tummy rumble and quickly take a huge bite.; the right choice: Greet Pippin warmly and ask if he would like to sit together.

setting: Shady Willow Tree by the Brook; event: Pippin mentions he couldn't find any berries today and gazes wistfully at Zuzu's bright orange carrot.; temptation: Clutch the whole carrot tight and say it is only enough for one bunny.; the right choice: Snap the crisp tip off the carrot and offer the sweet piece to Pippin.

setting: Bubbling Brook Stepping Stones; event: While walking together, they meet Barnaby the bluebird, who lost his trail mix in the tall grass.; temptation: Look away and hurry across the stones before Barnaby notices the carrot.; the right choice: Pause on the stones and ask Barnaby if he'd like a crunchy slice too.

setting: Daisy Circle Clearing; event: Zuzu looks down and sees she only has one last medium piece of carrot left for herself.; temptation: Keep the remaining piece tucked safely behind her back so no one else gets any.; the right choice: Realize that sharing made her friends smile, and divide the rest into equal nibbles.

setting: Old Oak Hollow; event: Pippin and Barnaby return with wild mint leaves and sweet clover flowers they found nearby to add to the feast.; temptation: Eat her own piece quickly without trying the new treats her friends brought.; the right choice: Combine all their snacks together on a broad green leaf to make a friendship salad.

setting: Sunset Hilltop Flower Bed; event: The friends crunch and laugh together as the sky turns warm pink and orange, matching Zuzu's bow.; temptation: Wish she had eaten the giant carrot all alone in silence.; the right choice: Celebrate how much more fun the afternoon was with friends sharing every bite.

setting: Cozy Burrow Doorstep at Twilight; event: Zuzu heads home with a happy heart, finding a basket of berries left by her friends as a thank-you gift.; temptation: Gobble the berries alone inside before bedtime.; the right choice: Save the berries to share with everyone at breakfast tomorrow.
